products.title: Aloe Vera
products.description: Known for its medicinal properties, its thick, fleshy leaves contain a soothing gel. Ideal for indoor and outdoor settings.

products.title: Caladium
products.description: A classic Caladium cultivar with large heart-shaped leaves featuring brilliant white centres and bold green margins and veins. Native to tropical South America, this tuberous plant is prized for its dramatic foliage contrast and thrives in warm humid shaded conditions.

products.title: Money Plant
products.description: Popular indoor money plant (Epipremnum aureum) known for its air-purifying qualities. Easy to grow in pots or hanging baskets.

products.title: Italian Cypress (Pencil Pine)
products.description: Tall, slender Italian Cypress with dark green foliage. Ideal for formal gardens and Mediterranean landscapes. Requires full sun and well-drained soil.

products.title: Red Maple
products.description: Elegant Japanese red maple sapling with vibrant red foliage. Thrives in temperate climates like Kashmir. Perfect for gardens and landscapes.
